topic: set exposure using the exposure triangle
core_question: How do I get a correctly exposed photo using aperture, shutter speed, and ISO? (secondary: How do I get sticky label residue off a glass jar?)
answer_summary: Adjust the three exposure controls together — aperture (light let in), shutter speed (exposure time), and ISO (sensor sensitivity) — so the camera's light meter is centered, trading one setting off against the others as needed for the scene.; after the topic shift: Apply Goo Gone or a coating of vegetable/cooking oil to the residue, let it soak in, then rub it off.
persona: friendly but persistent; writing in full careful sentences
